description:
Long-held properties in an area carrying a large paper gain — the classic
    off-market cohort, ordered by gain rather than by value.

    Typical output for a London district: mid-1990s purchases at £23,000-37,000
    now valued at £566,000-758,000.

    `area_id` is the marts area id from `area_resolve`.

    UK only. Costs 40 credits (40p).
name: long_held_high_equity
title: Long-held, high-equity properties
